title: Romani music - Wikipedia
text: There are five main components found in Romani folk music. The first is the use of three voices or parts: the melodic line, the terce and the quint, either through vocalization or instruments. The second is syncopation, where the music starts right after a beat while maintaining a consistent rhythm.
